typography.pairing_rationale: Manrope provides clean, geometric but friendly headings, while IBM Plex Sans offers dense, highly legible utility for complex file trees and data without looking like a generic template.

visual_enhancers.filmstrip: Add subtle perforation details to the filmstrip container to evoke analog contact sheets. Use a dark, near-black background (#110F0E) with CSS pseudo-elements creating repeating 'sprocket holes' (small dark squares) along the top and bottom borders.
visual_enhancers.draggable_overlay: The user-created category icons overlaid on the center image should sit in a glassmorphic floating toolbar. Use backdrop-blur-md bg-surface/60 border border-border/50 shadow-xl.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep backgrounds flat and solid (no gradients) to let photos pop, but surfaces can have a very subtle 1px inner border for depth.

components.image_thumbnail: h-32 w-auto object-cover rounded-sm border-2 border-transparent cursor-pointer hover:border-primary/50 transition-all opacity-70 hover:opacity-100
components.dropdown: Use Shadcn Select component customized with earthy dark colors, bg-surface, and solid backgrounds. ABSOLUTELY NO transparent dropdown backgrounds.
components.toast: Use Sonner for the Undo toast notification, positioned bottom-right, styled with bg-surface border-border text-text_primary shadow-lg.
components.modal: Use Shadcn Dialog for the Category Management modal. Require a backdrop overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm) and the modal body should be bg-surface border border-border.

motion.transitions: Use transition-colors and transition-opacity duration-200 ease-in-out for standard UI elements.
motion.hover_lift: Action buttons and toolbars can use a subtle hover:-translate-y-[1px].
motion.drag_and_drop: Use Framer Motion or a robust drag library for smooth, 60fps repositioning of the category icon overlay on the center image.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA on dark earthy backgrounds. Focus states MUST use primary color ring.
accessibility.keyboard_shortcuts: Crucial for a pro tool: All primary actions (Delete, Skip, Store, Undo) must have visible keyboard shortcut hints (e.g. 'Del', 'Space', 'S', '⌘Z') displayed in text-[10px] text-text_secondary next to the label or in a tooltip.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-labels on all icon-only buttons (like category icons).

media.images: Photos are the hero. Use object-contain for the center viewer to ensure the entire photo is visible without cropping. Use object-cover for the filmstrip thumbnails.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a desktop-like responsive layout using CSS Grid where left/right/bottom panels are fixed and independently scrollable, and the center viewer takes the remaining space.
The central column should contain the dropdowns (Date, Location, Categories) and action buttons at the top, and the main image viewer below.
Implement an absolute positioned draggable icon bar overlaid on top of the center image.
Do NOT use native HTML <select>. Use Shadcn Select component.
No emojis. Use lucide-react icons exclusively.
Implement Sonner toast for the Undo functionality.
Place the author credit footer 'Built for photographers • by [author]' discreetly at the bottom of the right panel.
Create a detailed tree-view structure for the left and right panels with expand/collapse icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate, but NEVER with fully transparent backgrounds on elements that overlap content.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This results in breaking transforms. Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles with tight padding and interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, active states.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Missing categories for images means use placeholder text, which is FORBIDDEN. ALWAYS USE PROVIDED IMAGES.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Professional density: Since this is a pro tool, spacing should be compact (p-2 to p-4) to maximize data visibility without feeling cluttered.
Visual Hierarchy: The selected photo in the center viewer is the highest priority. All chrome around it must visually recede into the earth-toned background.
Interaction Feedback: Every click (Delete, Skip, Store) must have immediate visual feedback and a subtle toast notification if the action is destructive.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
